AI Engineer 3 (AI Foundations)
description_html: AI Engineer 3 (AI Foundations)       At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.        Team Description:      The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand-in-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers.  Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact.       What You’ll Do:         Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.      Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, agents and multi-agent workflows, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc.      Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more.      Invent and introduce state-of-the-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems.      Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One.      Lead development and benchmarking of multi-turn conversational and tool-using agent workflows, ensuring measurable performance and safety metrics      Implement scalable pipelines for training, fine-tuning and deploying foundation or domain-specific models across multiple environments      Collaborate with research and data engineering teams to curate high-quality datasets and improve model evaluation methodologies      Contribute to governance and security efforts for model traceability, lineage documentation, and version control of deployed AI assets      Mentor junior AI engineers and advocate for engineering excellence, reproducibility, and responsible experimentation         The Ideal Candidate:        You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good    Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production    You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven    You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss    You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown      This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.       Basic Qualifications:         Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 3 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 1 year of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies      At least 3 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, CUDA, or Java         Preferred Qualifications:        Experience contributing to development of components of AI systems with tradeoff decisions around cost, latency, throughput and accuracy    4+ years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)    Experience developing, delivering, and supporting AI services    Experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies (e.g. LLM Inference, Similarity Search and VectorDBs, Guardrails, Memory) using Python, C++, C#, Java, CUDA, or Golang    Experience developing and applying state-of-the-art techniques for optimizing training and inference software to improve hardware utilization, latency, throughput, and cost    Experience in building agentic AI systems and agentic workflows    Demonstrated ability to evaluate and optimize LLM performance using quantitative metrics (accuracy, coherence, latency, cost)    Hands-on experience implementing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector database integrations, and fine-tuning workflows    Experience applying prompt-engineering strategies, safety guardrails, and red-teaming methodologies to production AI systems         Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position. This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan. description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Software Engineering    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.         We are looking for an exceptional Lead/Senior Member of Technical Staff to join the AgentExchange Buyer Experience team and help build the future of the Salesforce AgentExchange ecosystem. We are building the next-generation Buyer Experience Platform, which helps Salesforce customers discover solutions from our ISVs and partners and extend their Salesforce environment.   We want you to be part of this success story.    The Try and Buy team owns the applications and services that let customers browse and purchase solutions, write trusted reviews, and try and check out AgentExchange offerings. Our work includes: Lead generation and routing capabilities for partners, Partner-customer chat and agent experiences,  Try and checkout flows and Product and Consultant listing pages Our applications are primarily built with LWC and React, with integrations and services running across multiple platforms. The team is focused on streamlining, simplifying, and unifying the buying experience  .    As a Lead/Senior Engineer on this team, you'll be working with multiple teams across the platform to design, develop, and deliver solutions that define the buying experience for Salesforce's global customer ecosystem. The system you build will be extensively used by customers around the world to purchase applications developed by our ISVs and Partners    AgentExchange is building the next generation of our ecosystem marketplace, extending the base and the boundaries of our platform, while infusing intelligence through every step of our customers' and partners' journey. The new ecosystem enables packaging, publishing, and listing solutions across multiple technologies — including Agentforce, MuleSoft, Tableau, and Slack — while delivering full transactability within the AgentExchange (Discover → Purchase → Provision). The One AppExchange Framework is our dynamic, extensible data and services platform that expands the tenancy capabilities of the AgentExchange site, while also bringing our ecosystem to Trailblazers wherever they are.     Requirements       8+ years  of experience in software engineering, with a demonstrated track record of technical leadership on enterprise-scale, mission-critical systems.    Lead the architectural design and implementation of major components and new features for the AgentExchange Partner Experience, including Security Review workflows, LLM-assisted publishing pipelines, licensing, payments, and analytics surfaces.    Define and drive the long-term technical vision and architectural roadmap for the Buyer experience platform     Act as the technical authority for your domain — providing guidance, mentorship, and sponsorship to senior and junior engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.    Champion and drive a strong engineering culture: coding standards, code reviews, CI/CD, service ownership, and operational excellence.    Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Design, and partner engineering teams to translate complex partner requirements into robust, scalable, and elegant technical solutions.    Drive excellence across our full-stack TypeScript and JavaScript technologies, with a focus on partner experience, extensibility, developer productivity, scale, and performance.    Excellent object-oriented design skills anchored by experience applying design patterns in large-scale distributed systems.    Experienced with modern web technologies and full-stack application development:       Front End:  React, Angular, Next.js, or equivalent     Back End:  Node.js, Express, NestJS, or equivalent      Experience building scalable APIs and microservices in an enterprise software environment.    Experience with relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL) and the design of robust data models.    Experience with unit test frameworks and a strong commitment to test coverage.      Preferred Qualifications      A strong desire to learn technology and a polyglot attitude — willingness to span multiple languages and platforms.    A commitment to quality, stability, and performance across the entire software development lifecycle.    Experience with automated E2E testing frameworks.    Proven service ownership experience — including CI/CD familiarity and supporting and troubleshooting software in production.    Deep understanding of how to balance speed of delivery with long-term maintainability and technical health.    Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders.    Experience working with or building LLM-assisted workflows or AI-powered developer tooling.    Conversant with Salesforce Platform features and best practices.    Experienced in building on top of the Salesforce Platform, with expertise in Apex and Lightning Web Components.    Experienced in developing and maintaining packaged solutions for ISV or SaaS partner ecosystems.    Proficient in written and spoken English.             Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.      Accommodations    If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this      Accommodations Request Form     . title: Software Engineering Lead - GenAI Platforms
description_html: The Team & Culture  We are a research-driven startup operating within the enterprise. Our mission? Building the bank's next-generation GenAI platforms—Citi Stylus Workspaces and mission-critical AI infrastructure serving Citi employees globally. We move with startup velocity while maintaining enterprise-grade security, compliance, and reliability. We build at the frontier of AI, architecting scalable systems where cutting-edge models meet cloud-native excellence.   The Role  We are looking for a  Software Engineering Lead  who architects, codes, and leads. This is a senior technical leadership role (SVP) for someone who wants to drive the backend vision and full-stack execution of enterprise GenAI platforms. You will design high-performance AI systems at the intersection of modern cloud-native development and cutting-edge AI—combining hands-on engineering mastery with strategic technical leadership. You'll work with Claude, Gemini, and proprietary models on OpenShift/Kubernetes, building microservices that transform how employees interact with AI.   What You'll Do    Architect at Scale : Design and build core GenAI platform components serving 180,000+ users with exceptional performance, reliability, and security across distributed systems.     Engineer Full-Stack Excellence : Implement complex features across the entire stack—from Go microservices and document pipelines to React interfaces and real-time streaming architectures.     Lead AI/ML Innovation : Build production-grade LLM applications, architect vector databases, implement agentic capabilities, and optimize AI inference for performance and cost efficiency.     Own DevOps & Production : Design observability solutions, lead incident response and blameless postmortems, build CI/CD pipelines, and ensure production excellence through comprehensive monitoring and alerting.     Master Cloud Infrastructure : Architect Kubernetes/OpenShift deployments, implement service mesh (Istio), drive infrastructure-as-code and GitOps workflows, and ensure security best practices at every layer.     Drive Technical Vision : Set architectural direction across services and teams, mentor engineering talent, lead cross-functional collaboration with product and AI researchers, and represent engineering in leadership forums.    Who You Are    A Technical Architect : Expert-level Go programmer (5+ years) with deep concurrency knowledge, proficient in TypeScript/React (3+ years), and fluent in microservices architecture, clean code principles, and distributed systems design.     A Cloud-Native Expert : Deep understanding of Kubernetes/OpenShift, service mesh implementations, containerization at scale, and infrastructure-as-code with proven experience in high-throughput, low-latency systems.     A Production Leader : 15+ years software development experience with 5+ years in technical leadership, 5+ years with cloud-native architectures, and 3+ years with AI/ML systems in production—delivering enterprise-scale systems (10,000+ users) successfully.     An AI/ML Engineer : Practical experience implementing production LLM applications, prompt engineering, vector databases, streaming architectures, RAG patterns, and multi-agent orchestration.     A Strategic Influencer : Exceptional communicator who translates complex technical concepts into business value, partners with engineering, security, and business leaders, and drives engineering excellence through mentorship and best practices.     Mission-Driven : Passionate about AI-powered systems, hands-on when needed, comfortable with ambiguity, pragmatic under constraints, and relentlessly focused on quality and innovation.    Why Join Us?  This is your opportunity to architect the future of enterprise AI at global scale. You'll work with cutting-edge AI infrastructure, collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers, and build systems with real business impact across a global financial institution. SVP-level technical leadership with startup autonomy, enterprise resources, and the challenge of bringing frontier GenAI capabilities safely, securely, and at scale. If you're ready to define what's possible, we want you on our team.      Education : Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.    Technical Stack : Go microservices, React 19+/TypeScript, OpenShift/Kubernetes, MongoDB/Redis/S3, REST/gRPC/WebSockets, Claude/Gemini/proprietary LLMs, OAuth/JWT/Vault, GitOps CI/CD, Prometheus/Grafana/ELK.              ------------------------------------------------------               Job Family Group:   Technology             ------------------------------------------------------               Job Family:  Applications Development         ------------------------------------------------------           Time Type:  Full time   ------------------------------------------------------     Most Relevant Skills   Please see the requirements listed above. ------------------------------------------------------   Other Relevant Skills   For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter. ------------------------------------------------------    Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.             If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review     Accessibility at Citi  .
